decisions.reason: Builds on existing candle arch expertise with only a minor electronic addition, so the firm can interpret early results and improve.
Arched one-tier Christmas pyramid is a direct extension of core wooden pyramid capabilities, enabling learning from early market feedback.
Electronic music box falls outside the firm's wood-based absorptive capacity, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve.
Platform for the electronic music box depends on a non-core product line and shows low website visibility, reducing learning potential.
Christmas motif platform is tied to the same non-core electronic music box and lacks visibility, limiting assimilative capacity.
Christmas pyramid with Dresden theme leverages established wooden pyramid knowledge, allowing the firm to learn and adapt.
